title: The NASA Seal
slide_intent: Teach designers to choose an identifier that suits the occasion. A ceremonial setting calls for a different signal from an everyday communication.
strategic_value: NASA can preserve the seal’s associations with history and ceremony by reserving it for formal uses.
demonstration: The upper text assigns the seal to formal events and awards and distinguishes it from the logotype used in day-to-day communications. The seal appears by itself below.
practical_value: Choose the seal for the ceremonial uses identified here and give it a separate visual role from the everyday logotype.

content_islands.name: Occasion and use notes
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and guidance in columns at the top. Keep the instruction on combining the two identifiers with the rationale.

content_islands.name: Seal specimen
content_islands.spec: Center the circular black seal below the horizontal rule and preserve the large field around it.
